== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3100]] is assessed at 16% (uncertain). James’s c 1650 birth can fit an older George of the Campbeltown group, but the George birth estimate varies between c 1630 and c 1640. The citation currently attached to James describes Robert baptized in 1674, son of James and Janet Orr; it concerns the next generation and cannot prove James’s father.

A weak retained George hypothesis with a potentially short generation; no cited record names George as James’s father. The Robert baptism does not justify replacing James’s father with another James.

Next useful test: Locate a record naming James and his father or distinguish the contemporary Campbeltown Georges.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1496 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1496]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Selected uncertain Campbeltown family — 16 October 2026 ===

Select John [[Glasgow-1561]] as the uncertain working father of George [[Glasgow-3100]] of Campbeltown through possible identity with John’s indexed Linlithgow son George-1560 of 20 January 1622. A child baptised in 1622 could have been about 37 at Alexander’s 1659 Campbeltown event and about 28 in the approximate 1650 generation assigned to James and Agnes. This is a workable adult generation for the household. Prefer this comparison provisionally over the older 1605 Mid Calder George-1082, who would have been about 54 in 1659, without excluding that man. The 1627 Glasgow George-1090 is a close alternative, about 32 in 1659; his profile also carries a separate, unproved Fanne Smith household association requiring its own identity review. The preference is weak and practical: the 1622 child has no established incompatible adult fate, and the household timing is compatible. Missing later records are not positive identity evidence. No shared occupation, holding, spouse, witness or migration record identifies the Linlithgow child with the Campbeltown father. This is a very low-confidence family selection, not an identified migration or a record naming the adult’s father.

Select George [[Glasgow-3100]] as Agnes [[Glasgow-1562]]’s uncertain working father. This activates the existing geographic family suggestion: Agnes’s captured profile places her Longwill household in Campbeltown, with a 1670 marriage-year field and a son’s 1683 birth field, while George is the named father in the 1659 Campbeltown event. Their approximate parent/child generations permit an older daughter in that household. The same locality and generation make daughter a useful provisional placement alongside George’s attached James and recorded Alexander. The marriage year, child details and Agnes’s circa-1650 birth are profile-held leads, not a newly inspected parish entry. No source names Agnes’s father; a sister, cousin, other local family or unrecorded father remains possible.

George-1560 and George-3100 remain separate profile accounts of a possible single man; shared proposed parentage does not prove two distinct sons called George or an identity merge. The 1605 and 1627 childhood candidates remain viable, and the list is not exhaustive. A separate unrecorded childhood is possible. The illustrative ages assume baptism near birth. George-3100’s 1630 structured and 1640 narrative births are unsupported estimates; neither is silently replaced by a proved 1622 birth. The existing John review cites X1RN-XV7 whereas the child profile cites X1RN-XVQ; retain that reference difference for original-register comparison, without treating the citations as independent events. James-1496’s father link to George is inherited and unproved; its name pattern supplies no independent corroboration for the chosen childhood. Agnes’s 1670 marriage field does not establish her age. No birth year is altered to force a generation. Assess mothers separately. No mother is supplied for the 1622 child in this review and none is selected for the Campbeltown adult. Grizel [[Dunlop-3562]] is already the confidently marked mother of Alexander-3101 in the 1659 event, but that does not establish her maternity of Agnes or James. Her circa-1640 birth is also an unsupported estimate. Neither James nor Agnes receives a mother. The FMP 13 April 1659 birth-date field and Scotland’s People 12 April index date remain literal alternatives; the original entry and reference conventions are unresolved. The Auchinhork residence reading is not assigned a guessed modern place. John-1561’s own Andrew-of-Calder father and his other childhood-to-adult comparisons remain uncertain. No new original inspection, confident relationship upgrade, live WikiTree edit or identity merge is claimed.
